records.body__c: Vetter have cancelled our 12 Oct slot. I pushed back on the phone — they have a genuine chamber deviation and cannot hold it. Nothing earlier across Venlo, Petten or Daventry. Escalating because this is the validation lot, not a routine cycle.

records.sources_read__c: master agreement clause 7.3, Approved Supplier List, audit validity
records.body__c: Checked the master agreement: the booking was a non-committed capacity reservation, clause 7.3 permits reallocation on 30 days notice. No contractual claim and no penalty available. Scanned the ASL for alternative fill-finish capacity — Siegfried Hameln is approved, audit current to Mar 2028, already qualified for Abrysvo G2 and Elrexfio IV, and has capacity from 29 Sep.

If we move site, it is a half-cycle revalidation, not a full one, because the modality is unchanged. Realistically 21 days of protocol plus execution. I would want the protocol drafted against the Abrysvo G2 precedent so we are not writing it from scratch. Flagging that cycle development on a new chamber has overrun 5–8 days on two of our last seven transfers.

The bigger risk is not the 47 days, it is the CHMP review slot. We hold a Q4 window. If the dossier is not complete by mid-November we lose it and the next confirmed slot is February — that is another 31 days on top. Please treat the CHMP date as the real deadline.
